title: Mixed Event — The Climax! Kamiyama Cheer Squad! — Episode5 Receiving Support

meta.Event Outline: With the Sports Festival just around the corner, Kamiyama High School is abuzz with talk of the renowned cheering competition, which also piques Rui's interest. Suddenly, Mizuki approaches him with a request...

rows.Line: The next day
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (Alright...)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (We don't have much time left until the Sports Festival. Today will be my only chance to tell them about my idea.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
(Hehe...
I made my decision to tell them, but I keep looking for reasons to postpone this discussion.)

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: (I never thought that I'd be this apprehensive. This thing really has an annoying hold over me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Alright, the Sports Festival's just around the corner! Time to get in another good practice for the cheering competition... Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Rui?
Why's he standing in front of the door like that? Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, I've come up with a great idea.
From the top of the building, we could all...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This definitely requires more thought...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Come to think of it, he was acting kinda weird yesterday too. It's like he wanted to say something but decided against it at the last minute...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What if...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, Rui.
What are you doing standing in front of the door?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh? Mizuki...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
And what's with the face?
Does what you wanted to say yesterday have anything to do with it...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: A sharp eye as usual...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
How long have we known each other?
Anyway, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's something I want to say, but can't muster up the courage to do so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm afraid that saying what I want to do will drive everyone over to the other side again.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I can't seem to help it...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You should be fine, Rui...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: During the School Festival, you made me believe that you aren't stuck on the rooftop anymore. You can go to the other side...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can be with everyone now...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, why don't you just say what you mean?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'll be looking forward to hearing your idea, Mr. Directing Genius♪

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you...
Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, we're doing full runs from the top pretty well now! All that's left is to keep practicing and polishing it up!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: The part where we stand and turn is still giving me some trouble, so I'd like to work on that.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: Same. Particularly when the captain and I have to cross swords...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: May I have your attention for a moment, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Ah, Kamishiro, you're here.
Is there something you'd like to say?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, so...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd like to make a fairly significant change to our performance...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: So I'd like to try working this idea into the opening scene of our performance...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Currently, the blue fire is our central motif where it starts by burning quietly and ends up becoming a roaring flame. The “calm” before the “storm” if you will...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: However, the “calm” takes up far too much time as it stands. I fear that our audience will quickly lose interest if we're not careful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: My new idea would help make our opening scene much more explosive. By including it, I'm sure our audience will stay immersed in the world of the cheering competition until the end.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: K-Kamishiro, we get what you want to do, but we'd need a lot of time to practice it...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To get it down perfectly, we'd be cutting it very close... Just in time for the day of, I suspect.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line:
But...
It's already just around the corner...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: And this plan... You seriously think we can do this?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Naturally, I'll do everything I can to ensure your safety. I promise that none of you will get hurt.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: If we do somehow manage to pull off Kamishiro's idea, we'd look so awesome. We should be fine as long as we use some of those bungee cords as lifelines.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: Still, do we really have to go that far...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: Right. On top of the Sports Festival being right around the corner, we should probably avoid doing anything dangerous. Things the way they are seem fine, you know?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hang on...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Wait.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Captain...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: Kamishiro, you're certain that your idea will make our performance for the cheering competition just that much better?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line: As our trusted director, even if we do end up cutting it extremely close, you believe this will lead us to putting on the best performance we possibly can?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I need all of you behind me to make it happen...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Understood.
Then, there's no reason not to.
Am I right...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: B-But...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We went into this wanting to make this the best cheering competition ever.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I'm for Kamishiro's idea if it means we can make that a reality!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: This is gonna take some courage to pull off, but I agree that this is probably gonna make the crowd go absolutely wild.

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: Our current ideas are pretty good too. Throwing in something like this is bound to make us look that much better, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line: This could be cheering competition history in the making...

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Members
rows.Line:
Let's do it, you guys!
Everything we have until the day of!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Awesome!
Now that we've settled that, let's start practicing!

rows.Speaker: Blue Squad Captain
rows.Line:
Right. We don't have much time left.
Buck up, Kamishiro! We can't do this without your directions...!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (I wasn't sure how this would go down at first, but...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Good for you, Rui.)
The day of the Sports Festival
School Gate

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Whoa... So many people...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I just came to get the worksheet they gave us for homework. I completely forgot that the Sports Festival was today.)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (I'm guessing the classrooms are being used for seating. I'm kicking myself for leaving behind something on a day like this, but I'll just get out of here once I have what I need...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Ena?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, Mizuki. Hi.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
What are you doing here?
Night school students don't have to participate in the Sports Festival, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, I know!
You're here to see Li'l Bro.
He is on the cheer squad after all!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? No, that isn't why I'm here.
Also, the cheer squad?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wait, you don't know?
Li'l Bro's on the cheer squad for the red team, and I'm on the cheer squad for the blue team.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: You are?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yup.
Things sort of just happened and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I need to go get ready!
Later!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: The cheer squad? Mizuki and Akito?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
That sounds kinda fun.
Maybe I should stay and watch.
Campus

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Mizuki, there you are!
Where were you?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Sorry, sorry.
I ran into Ena just now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Ena?
Oh, is she here for Akito?

rows.Speaker: Announcer
rows.Line: The first-years' scavenger hunt will begin momentarily. Entrants, please start making your way to the grounds.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Wait, huh...?
Mizuki, aren't you supposed to be in that?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Crap, you're right!
Gotta go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Good luck! I'll be rooting for you!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Okay!
Thanks, An!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(The Sports Festival's really starting...
On top of the cheering competition, I need to do my best during all the other events!)
